title: Canonical proper forget-supports comparison with ordinary endpoints
statement: For a commutative ring A and a proper scheme morphism f:X→Y, define ordinaryProperForgetComparison A f to be the canonical isomorphism rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat A) f ≅ ordinaryFinitePushforward A f given by rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar.

source.place: The equation M = Rp2_* Delta_* M and substitution of canonical pullback counits.

proof.text: Unfold ordinaryProperForgetComparison; it is definitionally the existing canonical proper forget-supports isomorphism with the ordinary direct-image endpoint recorded.

from.place: Canonical proper comparison used by the diagonal normalization.

lean.statement:
def ordinaryProperForgetComparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] :
    rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ≅ ordinaryFinitePushforward A f
